- **Suburban Travel:** The posting mentions "suburbs." Since you prioritize walkability and urban environments, frequent hauls to suburban wedding venues (which MDM specializes in) may conflict with your lifestyle preferences.

### 6. RED FLAGS & LOGISTICS

You would likely find the work unfulfilling and your specialized RF/Audio skills would go entirely unused.
